Nguyen Van Linh Parkway runs from the centre of Ho Chi Minh City out towards the port, and along it are some of the newest office buildings in the country. The city named the road after the party leader who opened the economy in the late eighties, and most people who use it every day know the name without knowing the history.

Further north, in Ha Noi, the streets around Hoan Kiem Lake keep their older names: Hang Bac, Hang Dao, Hang Ma. Each one was a trade street once, and a few of them still sell what they were named for. Tourists walk them in the evening, when the traffic is closed off and the whole quarter fills up with people.
